name_zh: 博尔基亚/文莱/苏丹/石油/沙里亚/福利：苏丹石油沙里亚与福利绝对
name_en: Bolkiah/Brunei/Sultan/Oil/Sharia/Welfare: Sultan Oil Sharia & Welfare Absolute
description_zh: 哈桑纳尔·博尔基亚 (1946-) 文莱苏丹 (1967-)/石油/天然气/财富/沙里亚/法/福利/免费/医疗/教育/住房/无税/绝对/君主/马来/伊斯兰/君主/制/MIB/哲学/1984 独立/英国/保护/国/遗产/文莱/博尔基亚。核心模式：苏丹石油沙里亚福利 — 苏丹/石油/沙里亚/福利/绝对/君主/遗产/博尔基亚/文莱。体现 M305 苏丹/石油/沙里亚/福利/绝对 — 以"苏丹+石油+沙里亚+福利"四位一体，在资源/宗教/传统/现代四重融合中构建文莱苏丹石油沙里亚福利绝对范式。
description_en: Hassanal Bolkiah (1946-) Brunei Sultan (1967-)/oil/gas/wealth/Sharia/law/welfare/free/healthcare/education/housing/tax-free/absolute/monarchy/Malay/Islamic/monarchy/MIB/philosophy/1984 independence/British/protectorate/legacy/Brunei/Bolkiah. Core model: Sultan Oil Sharia Welfare — Sultan/oil/Sharia/welfare/absolute/monarchy/legacy/Bolkiah/Brunei. Exemplifies M305 Sultan/Oil/Sharia/Welfare/Absolute — quaternity of 'Sultan + oil + Sharia + welfare' building Bruneian Sultan oil Sharia welfare absolute paradigm amid quadruple fusion of resources/religion/tradition/modernity.
reason_zh: 博尔基亚非单纯石油苏丹，而是"苏丹+石油+沙里亚+福利"四位一体绝对君主。以石油财富支撑福利，以沙里亚法确立道德，以马来伊斯兰君主制(MIB)整合传统。M305 区隔于 M227 姆斯瓦蒂(斯威士兰)、M199 文莱(前)、M303 李光耀(法治)，核心在于"苏丹即传统锚点+石油即经济基石+沙里亚即道德法典+福利即社会契约"的文莱绝对君主范式。
reason_en: Bolkiah not mere oil sultan but 'Sultan + oil + Sharia + welfare' quaternity absolute monarch. Oil wealth funds welfare, Sharia law establishes morality, Malay Islamic Monarchy (MIB) integrates tradition. M305 distinct from M227 Mswati (Eswatini), M199 Brunei (previous), M303 Lee Kuan Yew (rule of law), core: 'Sultan as traditional anchor + oil as economic base + Sharia as moral code + welfare as social contract' Bruneian absolute monarchy paradigm.
